correctness.rationale: PASS: From the exact printed nonlinear profile equation substitute v=1-phi, giving the upstream linearized Q(lambda)=tau*c*lambda^3-D*lambda^2-c*lambda+1. The cited minimal speed is the unique positive y=c²/D root of F_-(y)=4r y²+(1-18r-27r²)y-4, r=tau/D>1. Independently expanded cubic discriminants (sympy) to check disc(Q)=D³[F_-(y)+36r*y+8]>0 for y>=y*. Vieta and Q(-infinity)<0<Q(0) imply one negative/two positive distinct roots. F_-(1/r)=5/r-22-27r<0 implies c>D/sqrt(tau); Q(1/sqrt(tau))=1-D/tau>0 and Q'(1/sqrt(tau))=2(c-D/sqrt(tau))>0 place both positive roots below the Bessel Laplace radius. Each e^{lambda_j xi} solves both ODE and convolution using Φ(lambda)=1/(1-tau*lambda²) and meets the exact positivity, normalization, monotonicity, convexity and left decay imposed on the source limiting solution. The primary arXiv full text §6 lines 958-1006 explicitly states that no such limiting solution exists, so that specific proof step is falsified. This does not disprove existence of nonlinear oscillatory profiles by another route.
